fields.name: catch_record_68

fields.evidence: Constructor 0; vtable +0x50 (f_71003f06b0) resets it to FLT_MAX (0x7F7FFFFF); f_71003f1460 keeps the smallest hit distance (hit record +0xC); vtable +0xC8 uses it as the list sort key (node+0x18) and inserts only when it is below a constant.

fields.evidence: Constructor -1; vtable +0xF8 (f_71003f1420, not exported) stores arg1; vtable +0xD0 compares it with grab_id.

notes: One class only (0x7104f6b6f0, 160 bytes); vtable 32 entries (0x00-0xF8). Exports without a dossier slot: catch_cut -> vtable +0x90 (f_71003f0870), cling_cut -> +0xA8 (f_71003f0c20), set_send_cut_event -> +0xB8 (f_71003f0e40), capture_object_id -> +0xE0 (f_71003f11c0). Exported getters that hold no field: is_catch (catching flag AND a LinkModule link test), capture_object_id (0x50000000 unless catching or arg, else the linked object id from LinkModule +0xD0/+0x1B8), check_damage (DamageModule +0x1C8 and LinkModule tests only), capture_pos_x_diff (computed: x distance between the linked victim's ModelModule node position and own PostureModule position, 0 when not catching), update_pos_cling (empty for this class). set_catch(id): sets send_cut_event=1; if id != 0x50000000 links via LinkModule +0x48, sets catching, sends a link event and a model-constraint link on catch_node. +0x30..+0x69 is a copy of the best catch hit record filled by the search callback f_71003f1460; +0x70..+0x8B is a list node {next, prev, owner, distance} of a global per-frame catch resolution list (equal distances broken by a xorshift RNG). No access found to +0x8C..+0x8F and +0x98..+0x9F (padding). The catch_record_* names are descriptive only.
